summary: Since round 4, the only change is in AppConversations' streamFn: it now passes `reasoning: "off"`, so app conversations no longer inherit the host's default thinking level and spend the 1024-token cap on reasoning. I checked the path. createOpenAILLMApi forwards the "off" value instead of the host default, and pi-ai's openai-completions streamSimple turns "off" into no reasoning effort, which for the Together format sends `reasoning: { enabled: false }`. The updated temp test runs with a host default of "low" and a reasoning-capable Together model, and checks that every app request has reasoning not enabled and no reasoning_effort. All temp tests pass, every changed line is covered or exempt with an acceptable reason, and no findings remain.
